## Structural problem and change

module boundaries are easier to maintain. Identify changed architecture docs.

## Related issue

Closes #ISSUE or Refs #ISSUE.

## Behavior preservation and validation

commands and results, plus before/after comparisons where needed. Explain

## Limitations

effects, or write None.
